  - region "Simple English explanation of Reflection in y-Axis":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Reflection in y-Axis" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Reflection in the y-axis sends (x,y) to (−x,y). (2,3) maps to (−2,3), and y=f(−x) is the left-right flip. Points on the y-axis stay fixed. A useful rule is y-axis reflection: (x,y)->(-x,y). You can learn Reflection in y-Axis by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Keep y, multiply x by −1, and check a point on the axis does not move. Example: Does y-axis reflection change y? Only x flips sign. No. So the answer is no."
    - paragraph: "In real life, mirror design: A left shape can mirror right. Watch out: Changing y during y-axis reflection. Reflection in y-axis changes x."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Does y-axis reflection change y?
      - generic "Compare your answer"
